about: Emberlei is Lothar Frey's third daughter by Leonella Lefford, born in 296 or 297 AC. She is younger than Tysane and Walda and older than Leana.
An infant during the events of A Dance with Dragons.
A knight whose individual activities are scarcely described.

Big Walder was fifty-two days older than Little Walder, despite being the smaller boy. Both were wards at Winterfell before becoming Ramsay's squires. Big Walder was more cautious and seldom joined his cousin's cruelties
Dickon and his twin Mathis were born in 294 AC to Jammos Frey and Sallei Paege. Big Walder, fostered at Winterfell, is their elder brother.
Mathis is Dickon Frey's twin, born in 294 AC to Jammos Frey and Sallei Paege. Their older brother is Big Walder.

Helped Walder negotiate with Catelyn. At the Red Wedding he passed out while trying to keep pace with the Greatjon's drinking. Walder Rivers later identified him as one of the men involved in killing Grey Wind.
Served as Damon Paege's squire.
Called Merry within the family. When presenting the Frey girls to Robb, Walder forgot her name and mocked her in front of the guests.
Morya is Walder Frey's third daughter and his eldest daughter by Alyssa Blackwood. She married Ser Flement Brax; their sons are Robert, Walder, and Jon.
Known as Tyta the Maid. She was among the Frey women presented to Robb before Edmure's wedding.

Escorted Catelyn on her mission to Renly and Storm's End. He left Riverrun with the other Freys after Robb married, but was absent from the Red Wedding. Daven Lannister later spoke of him as a decent man.
Known as Deaf Della.
Osmund, born in 297 AC, is the younger child of Benfrey Frey and his wife and cousin Jyanna. His elder sister is Della.
Completed his studies at the Citadel, took his vows and served the Hunters as maester at Longbow Hall.

A loyal squire who fought in Robb's battle guard in the Whispering Wood. He wanted to remain with the king after the broken marriage pact, but his family made him return. He was away from the Twins when the Red Wedding t

Her marriage to Edmure was presented as reconciliation, while the feast concealed a massacre. Edmure later said she knew the plan and had been forced to comply, explaining her tears. Pregnant afterwards, she prayed for a
Presented to Robb before Edmure's wedding. Rumours of Annara's affair with Black Walder cast doubt on her parentage, but the claim remained unconfirmed.
A Mallister page at Seagard who stayed there after Black Walder forced its surrender. Rumours about his parentage were never confirmed.
Intended for the Faith, he was training to become a septon.
Known as Tyr. Big Walder disliked him and omitted him when counting possible heirs to the Twins. Rumours surrounding his parentage remained unconfirmed.

Among the girls presented to Robb at the Twins. Claims that Black Walder was her father remained rumours.

An experienced knight trusted with military duties despite his bastardy. He accompanied Lothar to the negotiations at Riverrun and commanded the attack on the northern camps during the Red Wedding. He later served in the
A knight born within marriage, though Lord Walder still dismissed him for being a bastard's son.
Approached Robb alongside her legitimate relatives when the Frey women were presented. Lord Walder mocked her ancestry and sent her away.
Her place in the family lists is uncertain. The reference may describe Aemon's daughter rather than a separate girl.
Served House Rosby as a maester.
Jeyne is one of Lord Walder Frey's natural daughters. Her mother is unidentified. She bears the Riverlands bastard surname Rivers.
Commanded the riverlands outriders while Robb campaigned in the west and escorted Catelyn towards Riverrun. After Robb broke the marriage pact, Martyn left with the other Freys.
Tried to restrain Walder's rudeness to Catelyn during the crossing negotiations. Walder silenced him with an insult about his common-born mother.
Captured on the Green Fork, he was held at Harrenhal until ransomed. He later served in Roose Bolton's army alongside Aenys.
Mellara is a bastard daughter of Walder Frey. Her mother's identity is unknown. She bears the Riverlands surname Rivers.
Widowed when Benfrey died of his Red Wedding wound.
Competed in the Hand's tourney at King's Landing. His precise place in the Frey genealogy is not established.
